messages:
alex: Starting a low-impact migration tonight — add user_preferences.flags (nullable) + small hotpatch to preference sync job.
alex: Window: 2024-09-02 02:00-04:00 UTC. Aim: no exclusive locks > 45s on primary.
tara: Outline: 1) ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN (no default), 2) orchestrated async backfill with adaptive throttling, 3) VACUUM on partitions after completion.
li: Recommend checkpointing every 5k rows and exponential backoff if we see lock contention. We should also log progress to datadog.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: 2024-09-02 02:00-04:00 UTC (prod). Canary: eu-central-1 (2 hosts). Pin requested: app-runtime 3.3.0.
ops-bot: preflight monitors enabled: relation watcher for user_preferences, long-lock alerts at 45s/3m to #eng-oncall.
tara: Backfill plan: workers with job queue 'backfill-low' batch=2500, target ~150 rows/sec, pause on lock_wait > 45s. Resume points persisted to migrations.checkpoints.
li: SQL (quick path):
```sql
ALTER TABLE user_preferences ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS flags jsonb;
-- we'll avoid setting NOT NULL or DEFAULT to keep write paths cheap
```
alex: We'll gate the feature with ff:user_prefs_flags. Enable only after canary backfill completes for 1h.
li: Rollback steps: stop jobs, flip feature flag off, unpin runtime, and if needed restore DB snapshot taken at 01:30 UTC. Snapshot available for 30m.
tara: If we need index maintenance, do CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY; stagger per partition over 30m windows.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 02:00 UTC for group 'eu-canary-2'. Healthcheck policy: 3m steady state. Will post failures.
ops-bot: autovacuum check: ensure it's active. If autovacuum pauses during backfill, abort backfill and restart after enabling.
li: Metrics gating: abort if p95 write latency >700ms or if row-level lock wait spikes >100/s.
alex: Release note blurb: "Add nullable flags column to user_preferences. Backfilled asynchronously. Feature gated by ff:user_prefs_flags."
tara: I've added the runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/migrations#user_preferences
li: Final preflight at 01:45 UTC. If no blockers we'll proceed. :rocket:
